sections.title: Property damage restoration in Kaufman: review accessible damage at the first visit
paragraphs: We will ask about the incident, source status, and anything already removed or treated. Accessible affected components will be reviewed along with nearby contents. Concealed areas will have their limits explained rather than be included in an unsupported complete diagnosis.

sections.title: Perform the work the material requires
paragraphs: The proposal will identify extraction, drying, residue cleaning, affected-material handling, or the appropriate mold remediation arrangement. Access and equipment routes will be discussed before setup. Work assigned to another provider will remain distinct from our agreed tasks.

sections.title: Explain changes as the area is restored
